mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.7% for two consecutive months, it signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.7% for two months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and consumer credit signals a contraction in household demand, which depresses corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production and rising unemployment, supply chain disruptions signal an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods matching the recessionary supply shock regime, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers monetary policy tightening expectations that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer credit over the past 6 months indicates rising household spending power, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of rising unemployment and declining employment growth, labor market weakness reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods matching the labor market contraction regime, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 112.0 for two consecutive months signals reduced manufacturing output, which lowers corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 112.0 for two months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.
